Wortham’s verse translation of Bhartṛhari’s three centuries of verses, on polity and conduct (Nīti), love (Śṛṅgāra) and renunciation (Vairāgya), with a preface (London, 1886). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Satakas of Bhartrihari. Translated into English from the original Sanskrit by B. Hale Wortham · Bhartrhari, Wortham, Biscoe Hale, b. 1843? tr · 1886, 188 scanned pages. Published 1886; B. Hale Wortham died 1928; the verses are medieval; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
